features.description: Your website isn't an expensive decoration. It's the sharpest point of your digital presence. First, we understand where you are  → then we build the clearest path to where you're going.

console.text: Specifying 'overflow: visible' on img, video and canvas tags may cause them to produce visual content outside of the element bounds. See https://github.com/WICG/view-transitions/blob/main/debugging_ov
